{{Top|leg}}
'''Chattza clan armor''' was the traditional [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by members of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Chattza [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]] in the service of Rodian [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] began wearing [[Galeenia Protector Armor]], a modernized version of the Chattza clan armor.
